anchor.note: placed on the block, by a placement agent reading the comment against the text (medium): Patient access via PHR application paragraph in LHR relationships; proxy/delegated access not covered there.

public.text: Patient access is beneficial, but the specification does not clearly address proxy access, guardianship, minors, loss of capacity, deceased persons, shared devices, or domestic-safety risks.
public.suggestedRevision: Define representative and delegated access, age and capacity transitions, relationship verification, revocation, shared-device protection, safe communication, and access to records of deceased persons.
